rules.statement: A person who enters into occupation of property belonging to another with the latter's permission cannot acquire title to such property by prescription unless he gets rid of his character of licensee by doing some overt act showing an intention to possess adversely.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a person enters into occupation of property belonging to another with the latter's permission he cannot acquire title to such property by prescription unless he gets rid of his character of licensee by doing some overt act showing an intention to possess adversely.
